channel.title: Times of San Diego - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Times of San Diego (timesofsandiego.com)

item.title: Filming ICE is legal but exposes you to digital tracking. Here’s how to minimize the risk
item.description: The right to record is uneven across jurisdictions and vulnerable in practice, especially when police claim someone is interfering.

item.title: Beach and Bay Press: Dec. 5, 2025
item.description: The Jan. 5, 2026 Beach & Bay Press covers La Playa Taco Shop owner's month-long ICE detention, SeaWorld's Christmas Celebration with beluga whales meeting Santa, PB bar stabbing suspect release, anti-McDonald's eatery in Pacific Beach, Bubble Queen of Mission Bay, Winter Wonder at Belmont Park, Soulja Boy headlining SantaCon, and holiday events like parades and runs.

item.title: Police name officers, suspect involved in shooting last week
item.description: The shooting occurred Jan. 29 after police were investigating a domestic violence report involving a firearm at an apartment complex.

item.title: Review: Standing ovation for Payare and orchestra after Mahler’s feverish 7th
item.description: It’s the least played of Mahler’s ten symphonies, and an uncompromising test for conductor Rafael Payare and the orchestra.

item.title: ‘Lot of gumption’ – blind Japanese sailor to launch solo trans-Pacific crossing from San Diego
item.description: In 2013, blind Japanese sailor Mitsuhiro Iwamoto’s first trans-Pacific sailing attempt failed when a whale struck his boat. He's ready to try again.

item.title: Qualcomm reports record revenue, but issues warning over memory chip shortage
item.description: Qualcomm ended its first fiscal quarter with record revenue, but warned a growing shortage of memory chips would impact sales to its smartphone customers.

item.title: Community turns out for memorial of 6-year-old killed in Pacific Beach crash
item.description: Community members joined bicycle and public safety advocates on Feb. 3 in a memorial and ghost bike installation honoring Hudson O’Loughlin.

item.title: Agreement by Padre owner’s widow, brothers ends part of legal battle
item.description: Sheel Seidler, as part of “the parties’ agreement to resolve the matters between them,” has withdrawn most of the claims in a 2025 lawsuit.

item.title: Baby animals on board: Humane Society calls for virtual baby shower gifts
item.description: The San Diego Humane Society is asking the public to help stock its nurseries during the 16th annual virtual Wildlife Baby Shower.

item.title: Request to postpone trial amid Minnesota shootings denied for ex-SD deputy
item.description: A federal judge Wednesday denied a request from attorneys for a former San Diego County sheriff's deputy who fatally shot a fleeing, unarmed man outside the San Diego Central Jail to delay his trial.
